scope: Three alternating CPU-0 pinned process pairs each for all six preserved modeling/branch workflows, all four plane/pcurve workflows and all ten rational-surface/affine workflows. Three absolute processes cover all five new branch-replay groups. Every call retains assertions, required topology validation, output materialization and replay. First and three repeated fresh-input calls are separate phases; this is not an eviction campaign.
limits: Rust allocation counts and requested traffic exclude foreign allocators and are not live heap. Shared-host timings establish no speedup. New successful contracts have no previous successful timing baseline. All adverse observations are retained.
